verdict.rationale: Gazebo ships official C++ libraries that developers build against directly in their own applications, such as gz-math, sdformat and gz-transport. It also provides a plugin API for extending gz-sim, gz-sim as an embeddable library with standalone example programs, and a C++ client library for Gazebo Fuel. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages other than C++ (e.g. Python bindings), detailed API reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the developer experience.
